title: 3.3.12 Sum an Array
description: Use a for loop to add up all numbers in an array, then log the total. Auto-graded: the code runs and the total is checked.

steps.title: Start with the numbers
steps.instructions: The starter already creates the array: let numbers = [10, 25, 7, 42];. Leave that line exactly as it is.

steps.title: Sum with a for loop
steps.instructions: Create a variable called total and set it to 0. Write a for loop that visits every element in numbers: either by index (from 0 up to numbers.length - 1) or with for...of. On each iteration, add the current element to total.

steps.title: Log the result
steps.instructions: After the loop, use console.log to print the value of total.

requirements.title: for loop present
requirements.description: Code contains a for loop. Help: 3.3.5 (Looping Over Arrays (for / for…of))
requirements.hint: Write a for loop (for (let i = 0; ...) or for (const n of numbers)) that visits every element.

requirements.title: the loop adds to total
requirements.description: A for loop body adds each element to a running total (total += ..., or total = total + ...). Adding the same number every time, like total += 1, counts items instead of summing them. Help: 3.3.5 (Looping Over Arrays (for / for…of))
requirements.hint: Inside the loop, add the current element itself to the total (total += numbers[i]). Adding the same number every time counts items instead.

requirements.title: console.log present
requirements.description: Code calls console.log. Help: 3.3.5 (Looping Over Arrays (for / for…of))
requirements.hint: After the loop, print with console.log(total);

requirements.title: total is the sum of numbers
requirements.description: After the code runs, numbers is still 10, 25, 7, 42 and total holds their sum, 84. Help: 3.3.5 (Looping Over Arrays (for / for…of))
requirements.hint: Start total at 0 and add every element once. The loop must reach the last element, and numbers must stay exactly as the starter gave it.

requirements.title: the total is printed
requirements.description: The output shows the total, 84. Help: 3.3.5 (Looping Over Arrays (for / for…of))
requirements.hint: Print total AFTER the loop ends, so the finished sum (84) is in the output.
